summary: Engineering preview: every retained old screen now routes through native Instrument Teal parameter, list, grid, name/confirmation and result families, including advanced FM6/VA, Layer, effects, recordings, system, diagnostics and recovery. HOME/banks, Groove/Loop/Mix/Click and the protected sixteen-slot editor retain their existing musical owners. Finite chord/cursor/knob/bank/workspace/focus/save transitions and a real post-MASTER output-driven halo share the single On/Off setting; Off cancels visual work and settled views skip rendering. The current manual-take/latest-three policy remains intact. Numbered Songs, arranged recording, Learn/Next, chord library/audition and physical verification remain pending; the user has explicitly deferred chord library/audition.
